mapper.sql: c.id AS conversation_id, c.conversation_type, CASE c.conversation_type WHEN 'TASK_SERVICE' THEN '任务沟通' WHEN 'ADMIN_SUPPORT' THEN '管理员客服' END AS conversation_type_name, c.task_id, task.task_no, c.subject, c.status, CASE c.status WHEN 'WAITING' THEN '等待管理员认领' WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN '沟通中' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN '已关闭' END AS status_name, c.last_message_id, CASE WHEN last_message.deleted = 1 THEN '[消息已删除]' ELSE last_message.content END AS last_message_content, last_message.sender_id AS last_message_sender_id, last_message.sender_role AS last_message_sender_role, c.last_message_at, c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_conversation WHERE id = #{conversationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.id AS conversation_id, c.conversation_type, CASE c.conversation_type WHEN 'TASK_SERVICE' THEN '任务沟通' WHEN 'ADMIN_SUPPORT' THEN '管理员客服' END AS conversation_type_name, c.task_id, task.task_no, meter.meter_no, meter.meter_name, c.subject, c.status, CASE c.status WHEN 'WAITING' THEN '等待管理员认领' WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN '沟通中' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN '已关闭' END AS status_name, c.created_by, creator.display_name AS creator_display_name, c.closed_by, closer.display_name AS closed_by_display_name, c.close_reason, c.closed_at, c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM chat_conversation AS c LEFT JOIN meter_reading_task AS task ON task.id = c.task_id LEFT JOIN meter ON meter.id = task.meter_id INNER JOIN sys_user AS creator ON creator.id = c.created_by LEFT JOIN sys_user AS closer ON closer.id = c.closed_by WHERE c.id = #{conversationId} LIMIT 1
